Knowledge cutoff: 2024-06
Current date: 2026-03-11

Reasoning: medium

# Valid channels: analysis, commentary, final. Channel must be included for every message.
Calls to these tools must go to the commentary channel: 'functions'.<|end|><|start|>developer<|message|>

# Tools

## functions

namespace functions {

// Return the average molecular weight (Daltons).
type get_molecular_weight = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return the monoisotopic exact molecular weight (Daltons).
type get_exact_molecular_weight = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return the number of non-hydrogen atoms (heavy atoms).
type get_heavy_atom_count = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Wildman–Crippen cLogP (octanol/water).
type get_mol_logp = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return topological polar surface area TPSA (Å^2).
type get_tpsa = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Lipinski H-bond donors count.
type get_hbd = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Lipinski H-bond acceptors count.
type get_hba = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return rotatable bonds count.
type get_num_rotatable_bonds = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return FractionCSP3 = (# sp3 carbon atoms)/(# total carbon atoms), Often used as a simple “3D character / saturation” proxy from 2D structure.
type get_fraction_csp3 = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Wildman–Crippen molar refractivity (MR).
type get_mol_mr = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return total ring count.
type get_ring_count = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return aromatic ring count.
type get_num_aromatic_rings = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return net formal charge (sum of atom formal charges as encoded in the SMILES).
type get_formal_charge = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return QED (Quantitative Estimate of Drug-likeness) as implemented in RDKit.
type get_qed = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return heteroatom count (non C/H).
type get_num_heteroatoms = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Analyze fused ring systems (clusters of rings sharing bonds) and report their topology, aromaticity, and heteroatom content. Distinguishes fused polycyclic systems from isolated rings. Useful for AMES mutagenicity (detecting PAH-like systems), hERG (extended flat aromatic surfaces), and general structural classification of ring complexity.
type analyze_ring_systems = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Classify the ionization state of a molecule at a target pH using Dimorphite-DL. Returns a formatted string with charge distributions.
type classify_ionization = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string,
// Target pH for protonation (default: 7.4, physiological).
ph?: number
}) => any;

// Compute fingerprint similarity (Morgan by default) between a query SMILES and a list of reference SMILES. Returns a formatted string.
type compute_similarity = (_: {
// Query SMILES string.
smiles: string,
// List of reference SMILES strings to compare against.
reference_smiles: string[]
}) => any;

// Screen a SMILES against RDKit's built-in structural alert catalogs. Returns a formatted string of alerts found.
type score_structural_alerts = (_: {
// Query SMILES string.
smiles: string,
// Which alert library to use. 'all' uses all available libraries.
alert_library?: "brenk" | "nih" | "chembl" | "zinc" | "all", // default: all
}) => any;

// Extract pharmacophore features using RDKit's BaseFeatures definitions.
type extract_pharmacophore_features = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Accurately parse functional groups with attachment points, corresponding fragment SMILES, and atom ids in the SMILES string for better structure description.
type describe_high_level_fg_fragments = (_: {
// The SMILES string to parse.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Test whether a molecule contains the given SMARTS substructures and count occurrences.
type match_substructure = (_: {
// The SMILES string of the molecule. Do not pass in an ellipsis (`...`) or other abbreviation.
smiles: string,
// Mapping of pattern name to SMARTS string.
patterns: object
}) => any;

// Find the maximum common substructure (MCS) across query + reference SMILES. The output is a single structure present in ALL provided molecules. To compare very different molecules, call this tool multiple times individually rather than placing all molecules in a single list.
type find_mcs = (_: {
// Query SMILES.
smiles: string,
// Reference SMILES to include in the MCS search.
reference_smiles: string[]
}) => any;

// Desalt a SMILES by removing salts/counterions and keeping ONLY the largest organic fragment. Use this tool when the SMILES contains multiple disconnected components separated by '.' and one or more components are likely inorganic ions/solvents (e.g., [Na+], Cl-, Br-, I-, [K+], [Li+], [Ca2+], [Mg2+], [NH4+], sulfate/phosphate, etc.), or when you want the parent (active) molecule for downstream property prediction.
In aqueous/physiological conditions, salts typically dissociate; counterions are usually not part of the parent drug structure for many structure-based predictions.
Typical examples needing desalting: 'CC(=O)O.[Na+]', '[Na+].O=C(O)c1ccccc1', 'CCO.Cl'.
Do NOT use if the SMILES is already a single component (no '.') or if multiple organic fragments represent real mixture/co-crystal/combination therapy that should be kept. Output is the canonical SMILES of the retained parent fragment; smaller fragments are discarded.
type remove_salts = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Screen a molecule against RDKit's built-in structural alert catalogs (PAINS, Brenk, NIH, ZINC, ChEMBL, etc.).
type score_structural_alerts = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string,
// Alert library to screen against (default: all).
alert_library?: "all" | "pains" | "pains_a" | "pains_b" | "pains_c" | "brenk" | "nih" | "zinc" | "chembl" | "chembl_bms" | "chembl_lint" | "chembl_mlsmr"
}) => any;

// Return Labute approximate surface area (ASA proxy).
type get_labute_asa = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Bertz complexity index.
type get_bertz_ct = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return IPC (information content).
type get_ipc = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Hall–Kier alpha.
type get_hall_kier_alpha = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Kappa1 shape index.
type get_kappa1 = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Kappa2 shape index.
type get_kappa2 = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Kappa3 shape index.
type get_kappa3 = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return atom stereocenter count.
type get_num_atom_stereo_centers = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return unspecified stereocenter count.
type get_num_unspecified_atom_stereo_centers = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return estimated ESOL logS (solubility proxy).
type get_esol = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

} // namespace functions<|end|><|start|>user<|message|>Instructions: Answer the following question about drug properties.
Context: Humans are exposed to a variety of chemicals through food, household products, and medicines, some of which can be toxic, leading to over 30% of promising pharmaceuticals failing in human trials due to toxicity. Toxic drugs can be identified from clinical trials that failed due to toxicity, while non-toxic drugs can be identified from FDA approval status or from clinical trials that report no toxicity.
Question: Given a drug SMILES string, predict whether it
(A) is not toxic (B) is toxic
Drug SMILES: COc1ccc2c3c1O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O)C=C[C@@]31CC[NH+](C)C2
Please think step by step and use the relevant tools in your analysis. Then put your final choice ((A) or (B)) after "Answer:"<|end|><|start|>assistant

# Tools

## functions

namespace functions {

// Return the average molecular weight (Daltons).
type get_molecular_weight = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return the monoisotopic exact molecular weight (Daltons).
type get_exact_molecular_weight = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return the number of non-hydrogen atoms (heavy atoms).
type get_heavy_atom_count = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Wildman–Crippen cLogP (octanol/water).
type get_mol_logp = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return topological polar surface area TPSA (Å^2).
type get_tpsa = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Lipinski H-bond donors count.
type get_hbd = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Lipinski H-bond acceptors count.
type get_hba = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return rotatable bonds count.
type get_num_rotatable_bonds = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return FractionCSP3 = (# sp3 carbon atoms)/(# total carbon atoms), Often used as a simple “3D character / saturation” proxy from 2D structure.
type get_fraction_csp3 = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Wildman–Crippen molar refractivity (MR).
type get_mol_mr = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return total ring count.
type get_ring_count = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return aromatic ring count.
type get_num_aromatic_rings = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return net formal charge (sum of atom formal charges as encoded in the SMILES).
type get_formal_charge = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return QED (Quantitative Estimate of Drug-likeness) as implemented in RDKit.
type get_qed = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return heteroatom count (non C/H).
type get_num_heteroatoms = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Analyze fused ring systems (clusters of rings sharing bonds) and report their topology, aromaticity, and heteroatom content. Distinguishes fused polycyclic systems from isolated rings. Useful for AMES mutagenicity (detecting PAH-like systems), hERG (extended flat aromatic surfaces), and general structural classification of ring complexity.
type analyze_ring_systems = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Classify the ionization state of a molecule at a target pH using Dimorphite-DL. Returns a formatted string with charge distributions.
type classify_ionization = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string,
// Target pH for protonation (default: 7.4, physiological).
ph?: number
}) => any;

// Compute fingerprint similarity (Morgan by default) between a query SMILES and a list of reference SMILES. Returns a formatted string.
type compute_similarity = (_: {
// Query SMILES string.
smiles: string,
// List of reference SMILES strings to compare against.
reference_smiles: string[]
}) => any;

// Screen a SMILES against RDKit's built-in structural alert catalogs. Returns a formatted string of alerts found.
type score_structural_alerts = (_: {
// Query SMILES string.
smiles: string,
// Which alert library to use. 'all' uses all available libraries.
alert_library?: "brenk" | "nih" | "chembl" | "zinc" | "all", // default: all
}) => any;

// Extract pharmacophore features using RDKit's BaseFeatures definitions.
type extract_pharmacophore_features = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Accurately parse functional groups with attachment points, corresponding fragment SMILES, and atom ids in the SMILES string for better structure description.
type describe_high_level_fg_fragments = (_: {
// The SMILES string to parse.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Test whether a molecule contains the given SMARTS substructures and count occurrences.
type match_substructure = (_: {
// The SMILES string of the molecule. Do not pass in an ellipsis (`...`) or other abbreviation.
smiles: string,
// Mapping of pattern name to SMARTS string.
